title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Deep Sea Python
desc: Fisherman Chen Yue and photographer Zhong Ming must set aside their differences after being attacked by a sea creature in the middle of the ocean.

title: Sheshnaag
desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.

title: China Gate
desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

title: Karthikeya 2
desc: The movie deals with the personal problems of Karthik and how he comes out of them. His pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of ancient Indian system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

title: Hero The Bullet
desc: Shiva, a young man, is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.
